en.topic_title: ‘A Symphony of Lights’ to dim for good next Wednesday after 22-year run
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s 10-minute light and sound show, “A Symphony of Lights,” is scheduled to stage its final show next Wednesday after a 22-year presence on the city’s skyline, the Hong Kong Tourism Board has announced.
